title: How Google Does It: Building the largest known Kubernetes cluster, with 130,000 nodes
summary: Stops reads from swamping a huge GKE cluster's datastore by serving consistent and paged lists from API server memory.

title: Colossus: the secret ingredient in Rapid Storage’s high performance
summary: Cuts Cloud Storage latency with streams that check auth once, then read and append on disks via a Colossus handle.

title: AlloyDB for PostgreSQL under the hood: Intelligent, database-aware storage
summary: Ends per-replica Postgres copies by having AlloyDB's storage replay the WAL into blocks that every node reads.
